Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Ga Mantse commends Interior Minister for efforts to promote peace and security Source : myjoyonline.com 22 October 2026 5:18am Audio By Carbonatix
The Ga Mantse, King Tackie Teiko Tsuru II, has commended the Minister for the Interior, Muntaka Mohammed-Mubarak, for his efforts to promote peace and security across Ghana.
The commendation came when the Interior Minister paid a courtesy call on the Ga Mantse at his residence to discuss issues of mutual interest, including national security and cooperation between the Ministry and traditional authorities.
The meeting provided an opportunity for discussions on the role of traditional leadership in supporting peace and security, as well as strengthening collaboration with state institutions.
The engagement underscores the importance of cooperation between government institutions and traditional authorities in addressing security concerns and promoting peaceful communities across the country.
